evidence.claim: The government maintained the Tigray internet and telecom blackout during the coverage period and applied pressure that encouraged self-censorship, while connectivity restrictions were also used in other regions.
evidence.title: Ethiopia: Freedom on the Net 2022 Country Report
evidence.excerpt: The government maintained the Tigray internet and telecom blackout during the coverage period and applied pressure that encouraged self-censorship, while connectivity restrictions were also used in other regions.
evidence.source_locator: Overview, B4, and C1 sections, lines 84, 248-248, and 396-398
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Specialized digital-rights assessment with concrete 2022 observations about shutdowns and information pressure.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Attributable to the federal government and security apparatus under Abiy’s premiership; the report describes state-side control of connectivity and pressure on media actors.
contrary_evidence: The same report notes no nationwide shutdown in the full coverage period, so the record is regionally uneven rather than totalizing.
Some disruptions were localized and partly linked to conflict zones.

evidence.claim: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed announced a national anti-corruption committee, said corruption had become a security threat, and said the committee would bring culprits before court.
evidence.title: Gov’t Establishes National Committee To Coordinate Anti-Corruption Campaign
evidence.excerpt: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed announced a national anti-corruption committee, said corruption had become a security threat, and said the committee would bring culprits before court.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official government reporting with direct attribution to Abiy; strong for the fact of the announcement, weaker for effectiveness or neutrality.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to Abiy as PM; shows his stated anti-corruption posture and an executive action he ordered.
contrary_evidence: Self-report does not establish unbiased enforcement or real effectiveness
Other 2022 reporting still described widespread corruption and weak accountability

evidence.claim: Abiy told parliament judges were the number one thieves, described the justice system as a sanctuary of thieves, and said prosecutors, police, and auditors were also corrupt while promising serious reform.
evidence.title: PM’s Comment On Judges Offends Association
evidence.excerpt: Abiy told parliament judges were the number one thieves, described the justice system as a sanctuary of thieves, and said prosecutors, police, and auditors were also corrupt while promising serious reform.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous local reporting with direct quotations from the parliamentary address, but not an independent transcript or audit.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct public statement by Abiy; it supports candor about systemic corruption, though it could also be read as political scapegoating.
contrary_evidence: The statement is denunciatory and not itself proof of truthful disclosure
No independent finding here proves the alleged corruption claims were accurate in the same form

evidence.claim: The article says Meseret Damtie was chosen by Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed in June 2022 to head the Office of the Federal Auditor General, a post that had been vacant for one year, and that she brought long public-finance experience to the role.
evidence.title: The Executive Is Happy When Taking Budget, But Unhappy When They See Our Auditors,
evidence.excerpt: The article says Meseret Damtie was chosen by Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed in June 2022 to head the Office of the Federal Auditor General, a post that had been vacant for one year, and that she brought long public-finance experience to the role.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Local interview/profile with specific appointment details, but still a secondary source and not a nomination record.
evidence.ruler_attribution: The appointment is attributed to Abiy as PM; it is relevant to whether he empowered a professional oversight office rather than leaving it vacant.
contrary_evidence: Appointment quality does not prove independence in practice
The same interview says executive institutions often do not provide documents promptly to auditors

evidence.claim: Reuters reported that parliament ended a six-month state of emergency early; the emergency had allowed detention without charge and warrantless home searches, and lifting it curtailed those extraordinary powers.
evidence.title: Ethiopia's parliament lifts state of emergency early
evidence.excerpt: Reuters reported that parliament ended a six-month state of emergency early; the emergency had allowed detention without charge and warrantless home searches, and lifting it curtailed those extraordinary powers.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Reuters reporting gives a precise procedural account of the emergency rollback and its legal effects.
evidence.ruler_attribution: The cabinet had approved the early end and Abiy’s government was the author of the emergency regime, so the restraint is attributable to the administration.
contrary_evidence: The emergency had already enabled mass detention and search powers
Ending the emergency does not erase prior abuse

evidence.claim: Abiy told lawmakers that the parties had discussed, agreed, and signed the peace deal and that the next step was to implement it, adding that the cease-fire required unhindered aid access to Tigray.
evidence.title: Ethiopia's Abiy Says He's Committed to Implementing Tigray Peace Deal
evidence.excerpt: Abiy told lawmakers that the parties had discussed, agreed, and signed the peace deal and that the next step was to implement it, adding that the cease-fire required unhindered aid access to Tigray.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Clear direct quotation in contemporaneous reporting, though still a secondary source rather than a transcript.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to Abiy’s public commitment before parliament; relevant as a promise/commitment record rather than proof of truthfulness.
contrary_evidence: Subsequent reporting still documented implementation gaps and continuing conflict pressures
A promise of implementation is not evidence that the promise was kept

evidence.claim: The National Anti-Corruption Committee said it had started arresting individuals for alleged corrupt practices, including officials accused of financial plundering and land grabbing.
evidence.title: Nat'l Anti-Corruption Committee Detaining Suspects for Corrupt Practices
evidence.excerpt: The National Anti-Corruption Committee said it had started arresting individuals for alleged corrupt practices, including officials accused of financial plundering and land grabbing.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official government news source reporting enforcement actions, but the underlying cases are not independently adjudicated in the article.
evidence.ruler_attribution: This reflects an anti-corruption campaign authorized by Abiy’s government; it helps show action, but not necessarily clean or even-handed enforcement.
contrary_evidence: The article reports allegations and arrests, not convictions or due-process review
Selective anti-corruption sweeps can be politicized

Independent corroboration of who initiated the August 2022 renewed hostilities and how much control Abiy had over allied or Eritrean forces.
Independent corroboration of the Oromiya airstrike allegations and a clearer command chain for the regional security actors involved.
Fresh 2022 evidence on contestability and institutional independence beyond the 2021 election legacy.
Independent 2022 budget-execution and household-distribution evidence tying reforms to welfare outcomes.
More disaggregated 2022 welfare outcomes by region, displacement status, class, and gender, plus clearer direct ruler contribution versus donor or UN partnership.

Audited personal-finance, asset, beneficial-ownership, procurement, or campaign-finance evidence tied to Abiy or close family, plus independent findings on whether anti-corruption enforcement was selective or even-handed.
Direct internal decision-trail evidence on implementation bottlenecks, replacement of blockers, and independent 2022 budget-execution audits for the reform package.
